chapters.title: Prose 1: A Wrong Man in Worker's Paradise
chapters.content:
Author: Rabindranath Tagore
Summary/QA: Deals with an artist who reaches a worker's paradise where everyone is busy working, and how his art brings a playful and creative transformation to the busy inhabitants.

chapters.title: Prose 2: The Elixir of Life
chapters.content:
Author: C.V. Raman
Summary/QA: Explores the true value of water as the real 'elixir of life', discussing soil erosion, rain-fed tanks, and water conservation.

chapters.title: Prose 3: The Gift of the Magi
chapters.content:
Author: O. Henry
Summary/QA: A touching story about a young married couple who secretly sell their most prized possessions to buy Christmas gifts for each other, showing true love and sacrifice.

chapters.title: Prose 4: Louis Pasteur, Conqueror of Disease
chapters.content:
Author: E. Margaret Carhart
Summary/QA: Chronicles the life and scientific breakthroughs of Louis Pasteur in curing deadly diseases like anthrax and rabies.

chapters.title: Prose 5: What is Moral Action?
chapters.content:
Author: M.K. Gandhi
Summary/QA: Explores the core philosophy behind intention, duty, and true morality in human actions.

chapters.title: Prose 6: The Eyes are Not Here
chapters.content:
Author: Ruskin Bond
Summary/QA: A clever and subtle narrative about a blind train passenger interacting with a fellow traveler without revealing his blindness.

chapters.title: Prose 7: The Girl who was Anne Frank
chapters.content:
Author: Louis de Jong
Summary/QA: Highlights the tragic history and resilient character of Anne Frank through her world-famous diary.

chapters.title: Prose 8: A Village Cricket Match
chapters.content:
Author: A.G. Macdonell
Summary/QA: A humorous account of a chaotic and uniquely quirky village cricket match.

chapters.title: Prose 9: Consumerist Culture
chapters.content:
Author: Divya Joshi
Summary/QA: Examines modern consumer behavior, materialistic tendencies, and their impact on lifestyle.

chapters.title: Prose 10: The Pie and the Tart (Play)
chapters.content:
Author: Hugh Chesterman
Summary/QA: A lighthearted medieval farce involving two hungry vagabonds, a pastry cook, and a stolen pie.

chapters.title: Poem 1: To a Pair of Sarus Cranes
chapters.content:
Author: Manmohan Acharya
Summary/QA: A poignant poem depicting love, grief, and the brutal reality of poaching directed at mated birds.

chapters.title: Poem 2: Abraham Lincoln's Letter to His Son's Teacher
chapters.content:
Author: Abraham Lincoln
Summary/QA: A father's wise advice and expectations regarding values, integrity, and resilience for his son's education.

chapters.title: Poem 3: Vachana
chapters.content:
Author: Basavanna / Sharanas
Summary/QA: Explores spiritual devotion, dignity of labor, and honest living.

chapters.title: Poem 4: Lochinvar
chapters.content:
Author: Sir Walter Scott
Summary/QA: A romantic ballad about a brave young knight who gallantly crashes his beloved's wedding and elopes with her.

chapters.title: Poem 5: A Poison Tree
chapters.content:
Author: William Blake
Summary/QA: A symbolic poem detailing how suppressed anger grows and leads to destructive consequences.

chapters.title: Poem 6: The Stolen Boat
chapters.content:
Author: William Wordsworth
Summary/QA: An excerpt from 'The Prelude' capturing a young boy's guilt and awe-inspired encounter with nature after taking a boat without permission.

chapters.title: Poem 7: Mending Wall
chapters.content:
Author: Robert Frost
Summary/QA: Evaluates the boundaries, barriers, and human relationships symbolized by a stone wall shared by two neighbors.

chapters.title: Supplementary Reading 1: The Treasure Island
chapters.content:
Author: Robert Louis Stevenson (Adapted)
Summary/QA: An adventurous tale of pirates, hidden gold, maps, and young Jim Hawkins' courageous journey.

chapters.title: Supplementary Reading 2: Narayanpur Incident
chapters.content:
Author: Shashi Deshpande (Adapted)
Summary/QA: A patriotic story depicting children participating bravely in the Quit India Movement in a small village named Narayanpur.

chapters.title: Supplementary Reading 3: Ulysses and the Cyclops
chapters.content:
Author: Charles Lamb (Adapted)
Summary/QA: An adventurous Greek mythology tale highlighting how Ulysses uses clever wit and strategy to escape from the giant one-eyed monster Polyphemus.
